builtBy: one-off research on 2026-10-02 (16 teams; official school athletics sites, school papers, MaxPreps career and JV pages); transformed by a script, reviewed by hand
notes: An overlay on data/rosters.json, joined on team slug + MaxPreps athleteId. It never replaces a MaxPreps value: a field is filled only where MaxPreps has null, and where another source disagrees with MaxPreps the disagreement is recorded under conflicts and MaxPreps stays.

Every filled value names its source URL, its kind (school-site, school-pdf, news, maxpreps-jv, maxpreps-career) and a confidence: high = an official 2026-27 school roster or MaxPreps' own data for the same career; medium = a school-site profile field that is not season-dated, a school-paper statement, or a grade derived from a dated MaxPreps class year plus the years elapsed (derived: true); low = a profile field not tied to the season.

Names on a school roster that are not on MaxPreps are not added. JV rosters that school sites publish are out of scope, except that Los Gatos' MaxPreps list is the whole program and the school site says which rows are varsity and which JV.
si.com rosters were rejected: names only, and for several teams a different or prior-season list.
